{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
print(f'Number of customer_age == -1: {age_neg1_mask.sum()}')

# Check revenue column type and sample
print(f'Revenue dtype: {df["revenue"].dtype}')
print(f'Sample of revenue: {df["revenue"].head(5).tolist()}')"}
